title: Phase Summary
description: Machine-readable outcome of a phase completion analysis: milestone verification plus everything the phase's tasks reported, aggregated and traceable to the task that reported it.

phaseId.description: The phase this summarises, e.g. PHASE-3.

title.description: The phase title, copied from phase.json.

milestone.description: Whether the phase's milestone was reached, criterion by criterion.

reached.description: True only when every criterion is met. The phase status may be set to done only when this is true.

evidence.description: What was checked, and where. For an unmet criterion, what remains outstanding.

taskIds.description: The tasks this criterion was traced to.

tasks.description: Per-task roll-up: one entry for every task in the phase, readable or not.

readable.description: False when the task's artifacts could not be read as v2 step outputs; see unreadable[] for why.

deviations.description: Every implementation-result.deviations entry across the phase, each carrying the task that reported it.

techDebt.description: Every implementation-result.techDebt entry across the phase.

reviewFindings.description: Review comments worth carrying forward — typically the error and warning severities.

qaIssues.description: Every qa-result.issues entry across the phase.

adrCandidates.description: Candidates emitted by the phase's steps. Collecting them here does not promote them; writing a numbered ADR stays a human decision.

promotedTo.description: Path of the ADR this became, when a human promoted it.

recommendations.description: Impact on later phases. Each names the phase it affects, so it can be acted on when that phase is planned.

scopeItem.description: The specific scope item affected, when the impact is on one.

reason.description: What in this phase prompted it — a deviation, an item of debt, a review finding.

unreadable.description: Tasks whose artifacts could not be read as v2 step outputs. Present so a partial summary declares its own gaps instead of silently omitting them.

found.description: What was found instead, e.g. v1 prose artifacts.

plr.description: Path of the Phase Learning Record written for this phase.

attributed-item.description: An item reported by one task, kept attributed so every aggregate stays traceable to its source.

item.description: The reported text, verbatim from the step output.

category.description: Optional grouping, e.g. code-quality, test-coverage, architecture.

affectsPhase.description: A later phase this bears on. Set it when the item is the reason for a recommendation.
